additional_info.subject: Note from Customer
additional_info.body:
Hello,
an our customer had an issue while he was trying to recharge the EV with our APP. He tryied 6 times to charge, 5/6 times our backend give the message "Connection with FE is not active - message not sent"; 1/6 the authorization was ok, but the charge stopped with message "Generic error". At this time the customer said that on the display of the Chrger there was a "reboot" icon and on the app there was the message "unexpected error".
Could you do a check in your log to understand what happened?
Software Version: v6.0.3-0-g215cb74
OCPP Backend Connection: No

Hello Luca,
Hope you are doing well.
As we checked the router configuration remotely and rebooted the charger, the OCPP connection came back online for a few seconds, but then dropped again.
To investigate further, could you please confirm the following:
1.Since the SIM is showing as roaming, has a local SIM been tried instead of Vodafone?
2.Also, could you please confirm the network connectivity at the site and the data plan?
Regards,
